name: Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / VC Dimension (affine)
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)\geq\lceil\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)/2\rceil$.
proof: Project to a shattered set of size $d$. The projected class is the full $d$-cube, whose no-clashing teaching dimension is $\lceil d/2\rceil$. Taking the maximum over coordinate projections gives the claim.
proof_source: The argument in the proof of Theorem thm:stable-comp-low-NCTD-star in the LaTeX survey.
